song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: Not to know this is called His freedom — that is told;
and that itself is saṃsāra — to the deluded, a terror.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ

verses.craft: Dread bounded to fools (UNC): to-the-deluded keeps the bound; hi-emphasis in told.
verses.rejected: (a) universal terror → killed: autonomy unterrifying. (b) saṃsāra→cycle gloss → killed: load term.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa karuṇa-bhaya of bondage named / L2+L3 voice
